newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL MADRID DRAW 1-1 AT VALLADOLID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL MADRID DRAW 1-1 AT VALLADOLID.

text.p: Real Madrid could only manage a 1-1 draw at Valladolid on Saturday, but despite the setback will almost certainly spend the New Year's break on top of the Spanish first division.
With 39 points from 17 games, Real lead Deportivo Coruna by three points and arch-rivals Barcelona by five.
Deportivo need to win their game at Sporting Gijon on Sunday by five goals to take over on top.

Real took the lead from a set-piece move by Davor Suker in the 16th minute, but let the game slip away in the second half and Valladolid drew level when defender Rafael Alkorta scored a 58th minute own goal.
